desc: Parse input: read K, S, T from stdin, stripping whitespace.
Quick reject: if abs(len(S)-len(T)) > K, print No and exit; if S == T, print Yes and exit.
Implement banded DP: iterate rows over S, maintaining a window of columns j in [i-K, i+K] clipped to [0, len(T)].
In each cell compute dp[i][j] = min(delete, insert, replace/match) using only values within the band; use sentinel INF=K+1 for out-of-band cells.
After processing, check if dp[len(S)][len(T)] ≤ K; print Yes or No accordingly.
Optimize: rolling arrays of size 2K+2, bytes indexing, bound locals, per-row early exit; complexity O(N*(2K+1)).
Write complete program: input parsing, quick rejects, common prefix/suffix trim, banded DP, final Yes/No output.
Mentally verify edge cases: band boundary handling at j-i=±K (sentinel slot prevents wraparound corruption), trim overlap, trimmed-empty strings, exact-case output.
